product_one_liner.value: Gushwork provides AI marketing agents that help small and mid-sized businesses generate qualified inbound leads through Google and AI search.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes its agents as helping SMBs generate qualified inbound leads without hiring a full marketing team.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page lists monthly pricing starting at $900.

named_customers.notes: These names appear among Gushwork's customer case studies.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists Gushwork in the broader 51–200 employee range, which does not establish which of the requested narrower bands is correct; 101–200 is supplied only as a schema-compatible placeholder.

hq_location.notes: The company LinkedIn profile identifies San Francisco, California as its headquarters. A separate news report refers to Delaware as the headquarters state and Bengaluru as an office.

founded_year.notes: The company LinkedIn profile says Founded 2023.

eng_blog.notes: The readable index consists of marketing/future-of-search educational content and product launch content; it does not show at least two engineering-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation and footer list product, pricing, customer, company, privacy, and terms pages, but no public docs, help center, or developer portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board lists engineering, marketing, and sales positions, but none of the listed job titles is an AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: The public product and blog materials discuss external AI search services and models, but the company materials reviewed do not disclose which model or provider powers its product. The privacy policy did not yield a disclosed model-provider/subprocessor identification.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy/security information reviewed does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as a company certification.

last_funding.notes: Gushwork announced a $9 million seed round in February 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The $9 million seed round announced in February 2026 falls within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The active job board lists Account Executive, Business Development Representative, and Sales Development Representative openings.

launched_6mo.notes: The announcement index lists product updates in June and July 2026, including the AI Editor and the July 21 agentic-commerce launch; both are within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: I found no verifiable dated C-level or VP-level join/departure announcement, and no complete sufficiently small team roster or equivalent source to establish a negative.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A live Account Executive job posting names Zoho, HubSpot, and Salesforce as CRM proficiency examples.
